**Root Cause:** The `libz.so.1` symlink was missing from `/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`. This caused Python's `zipfile` module (and other modules that depend on zlib) to fail with `ImportError: libz.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory`.

**Fix:** Recreated the missing symlink:
```bash
ln -s libz.so.1.2.11 /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libz.so.1
```

Then ran `ldconfig` to update the library cache.
